title: Boundary traces of the incoming field
source_hypothesis: The entire compact L2 source has every compressed L2 order on one fixed neighborhood of the nonzero tangential glancing covector. ZE supplies ordinary incoming regularity at the glancing lift. All matrix lower terms and localization sources are retained.
reviewed_arguments: T0 fixes one compressed source neighborhood and the strict ordinary order threshold m<-1/2. The receiving trace is the continuous Sobolev trace, not an assumed restriction of the zero-extended source.

T1 proves normal-profile L2 estimates by partial Plancherel. Every Euler and base/frequency derivative is included. Full-frequency regularizers have uniform symbol bounds, and the ratio substitution retains its L2 Jacobian.

T2 uses the complete strongly lacunary cutoff, all tangential derivatives of the good part and the actual ordinary trace estimate. Every separated-support input term is smooth by the full kernel bounds.

T3 composes the actual compressed kernel with the profile. The density du/u=dr/r removes the input normal scale, and the exact r phase derivative is sigma/r^2. The L2 integral inequality is proved and used instead of a nonexistent uniform pointwise normal profile.

T4 treats both tangential frequency differences and both normal frequency ranges. It retains the residual full symbol, compact ratio endpoints and all derivatives. Each frequency integral has an explicit convergent bound and arbitrary decay on one fixed output cone.
T5 removes both full-frequency regularizers with uniform L2 and Sobolev trace bounds, then approximates the actual rough L2 input. This identifies the Fourier estimate with the actual operator trace.

T6 constructs the full ordinary matrix parametrix on both normal elliptic caps. The exact localized source and first-order commutator are retained. The remainder has finite-normal wavefront; all its relevant lifts are regular, and their compact normalized set gives a legitimate smooth pullback.

T7 proves the actual normal graph regularity from the complete PDE. A finite-normal Fourier multiplier gives approximation in both graph norms. The exact integral 2*lambda*(C-arctan(C)) identifies the ordinary normal restriction with the weak H-minus-one-half Green trace.

T8 proves both actual incoming boundary traces are microlocally smooth. It identifies only the imposed Dirichlet or Neumann datum in the respective problem, retains the physical -i sign and the full ordered Robin gauge, and does not infer the complementary boundary response.

The three full solutions check the one-sided resolvent and sharp L2 powers, the failure of an H1-only normal trace estimate, and the noncommuting Robin coefficient. Twenty-seven exact algebra checks supplement the proofs.

Eleven overlapping desktop captures, the full figure and two mobile samples were inspected. The figure legend was corrected and the changed captures re-inspected. All display and figure extents remain accessible.

Thirteen local entries bind to 1263 exact earlier entries in 72 maps, including 102 external Lebl proofs. The response of complementary boundary frequencies, sharp Airy mapping, strict propagation for the original weak solution and the full course remain unfinished. Internal export P514 closure is not claimed.
